meta.name: Good Cop, Bad Cop
meta.description: The Australian Federal Police–the glamour police force that was set-up after the Sydney Hilton Hotel Bombing in 1978–has enjoyed consistent showers of praise by politicians and the public ever since it’s inception. However, the once-lionised AFP is now being ridiculed for bungling, excessive secrecy and collusion after the catastrophic failings of the “terrorism case” against Dr Mohammed Haneef.Good Cop, Bad Copreveals how the Haneef case is a symptom of the deep cultural problems that beset the AFP…
